cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Co-Sign This
cards.instruction: Get someone to help by making them an official participant who shares responsibility for the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Could you co-sign the form for borrowing this barbecue? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll help carry it. That handle looks cracked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Good eye. Sign as joint custodian; we'll inspect it together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The owner wants a replacement by Sunday if it breaks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're co-chair of replacements too. I'll call the shops; you approve what we buy before either of us promises her anything.
